summary: Comprehensive testing of Forgot Password recovery flow completed. All backend and frontend tests passed. Manager-only self-service reset via secure one-time token (64-char hex, 15-min expiry) working correctly. Non-managers see 'contact your Manager' message. Rate limiting (3/hour) verified. Generic response hides email existence. bcrypt password hashing confirmed. Reset page with password match validation working.

features_verified: POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns generic success for all emails (manager, non-manager, unknown)
Token (64-char hex) appears in backend logs only for manager accounts
GET /api/auth/verify-reset-token returns {valid: true} for valid token
GET /api/auth/verify-reset-token returns {valid: false, reason: 'invalid'} for invalid token
POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token + password >= 6 chars succeeds
Token is invalidated after successful reset (verify returns false)
Login with new password works after reset
Login with old password fails after reset
Rate limiting: 4th request within 1 hour gets same generic message but no new token
Login page has 'Forgot password?' link pointing to /forgot-password
/forgot-password page shows email input form with Manager-only notice
After submitting email, shows success message with non-manager contact notice
/reset-password?token=VALID shows new password + confirm password form
/reset-password?token=INVALID shows 'link invalid' error with 'Request New Link' button
Reset form shows 'Passwords do not match' when passwords differ
Reset form shows 'Passwords match' when passwords match
Reset button disabled until passwords match and >= 6 chars
critical_code_review_comments: Backend password_reset.py: Correctly implements 64-char hex token with secrets.token_hex(32)
Backend password_reset.py: Rate limiting correctly counts tokens per email per hour

Backend password_reset.py: Token invalidation on use prevents replay attacks
Frontend ForgotPasswordPage.js: Correctly shows Manager-only notice and non-manager contact info
Frontend ResetPasswordPage.js: Correctly validates password match and minimum length
